blind_read: The monkey consulted a tripod telescope and then took notes.

evidence.observation: The muzzle aligns with the telescope eyepiece while the white note and pencil sit below the throat. The three tripod legs and yellow telescope keep their colors.

The head and pencil lower toward the page, with enough room between the paper and telescope to separate writing from sighting. The long note-taking exposure makes the follow-up readable at native size.
